finalText:
Added the 4.2.0 section to CHANGELOG.md. Out of 380 commits, only 27 were `fix`/`feat` — everything else (deps bumps, refactors, CI/test churn, doc tweaks) is invisible to someone installing the package, so I left it out.

One thing worth a second look: `fix(auth): return 401 for an expired token instead of 403` — I filed it under Fixed since it's correcting wrong behavior, but any client code branching on `403` for expired tokens will break. You may want to call it out under a `### Breaking` heading instead, or at least flag it to whoever owns the auth client.
